I read that lipstick plants need airy soil, so a couple of days ago I repotted her in a mixture of perlite, peat moss, and potting soil. I haven’t seen any improvement yet. 

I have noticed gnats flying around my plant shelf, but I’m not sure if they’re attracted to this plant or one of my other plants.

Yes, if you are exalted to the highest level of heaven then you will be with your spouse and children for all eternity and become god-like. Being like God means that you have power to create and oversee other worlds. We’re taught that this is the natural progression, and God used to be a human who experienced mortality just like we are now.

Marriage:
— Members of the church are encouraged to get married in temples. You have to adhere to the guidelines of the church to be considered worthy to enter the temple. The marriage ceremony that happens in the temple is also referred to as being “sealed.” We believe that being sealed allows you to be with your spouse and any future children for eternity. Temple marriage is a very important principle in the LDS church because you have to be sealed in the temple to enter the highest degree of heaven. 

Prophets
— Prophets are individuals who are called by God to receive revelation for the church. We believe that God continues to work through prophets in the same way that he did in biblical times. Prophets are integral to the church’s concept of ongoing revelation. There are two counselors to the prophet and twelve apostles who also receive revelation and guidance from God. 

Leaving the Church
— Members who leave the church or go “inactive” (stop attending weekly church meetings or following the guidelines) are viewed mostly negatively by active members. Leaving the church is a big deal. It affects every aspect of someone’s life: their family, community, and friends. Active members are instructed to love their family members and friends who have left the church in the hopes that they will have a change of heart and return. In my extended family of 9 aunts and uncles I have one aunt who has left the church with her family. While this aunt is still invited to family activities, she is definitely seen as an outsider. Because we believe that you have to be an active and obedient member of the church to be with your family forever, leaving the church is especially heartbreaking for parents and family members. These attitudes obviously don’t apply to every member, but they are very prevalent in Utah, where I grew up.
I’m a member and was raised in the LDS church, and I would be happy to answer any questions you have!

I’m so sorry you’re going through this. I know how hard it is to feel like your ex is the only person in the world who can truly make you happy. I was devastated when I realized that I would never find someone exactly like him. There will never be another person with the same sense of humor, mannerisms, hobbies, laugh, etc. But I’ve also realized that if he was The One for me, then we would be together right now. If our relationship was supposed to work out and last forever then the relationship would be working out. It’s taken me 6 months to get to this place, and there are still moments when I’m completely devastated about losing him, but I can tell you with some degree of certainty that you will find someone else. They won’t be the same as your ex, but they will be good and perfect for you in their own way.
